blocks.task_summary: Find P(B) given P(A ∪ B) = 5/8 and P(A ∩ B′) = 7/24.
method_path: Use law of addition: P(A ∪ B) = P(A ∩ B′) + P(B)

evidence.basis: attempt to use a Venn diagram OR law of addition (M1); P(A ∪ B) = P(A ∩ B′) + P(B) (A1); P(B) = 1/3 A1

blocks.task_summary: Given A and B are independent, find P(A′ | B).
method_path: Find P(A) using independence: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B) and P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B)
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 2: Find P(A ∩ B) = 7/48 using independence, then P(A′ | B) = 1 − P(A) + P(A ∩ B) − P(A ∪ B) / P(B) = 9/16

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: attempt to find P(A) M1; P(A) = 7/16 (A1); P(A′ | B) = P(A′) = 9/16 A1. METHOD 2: attempt to use P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B) M1; x = 7/48 A1; P(A′ | B) = 9/16 A1.
